children: Idaho Copper received U.S. Forest Service approval to commence drilling at the CuMo project and is targeting up to 15,000 feet of additional diamond core drilling this season.
USFS approved the Exploration Plan of Operations and 2026 annual operating plan, authorizing drilling, roadbuilding, and maintenance.
Approval effective for six years from first day of operations and follows 2025 Decision Notice and FONSI under an EA.
Company provided required reclamation surety bond and confirmed other permits are in place and in good standing.
Idaho Copper plans infill drilling this season and may drill up to 15,000 feet, with a larger 2027 campaign aimed at prefeasibility study work.
